symbols.reasoning: Up narrows required PayrollRuns.Period from nvarchar(max) to450 then creates filtered unique Period where Status is not Cancelled. Paid and Draft/Approved live records all count; cancelled runs may coexist. It deliberately does not choose/delete duplicate existing payroll, so upgrade can fail for conflicting data/oversized strings. Provider collision/lock behavior not executed.
